description: This file implements a media session client for UWP on Raspberry Pi 4, handling media playback state changes, media control button events, and callbacks for media session updates.

methods.name: MediaSessionPlaybackStateToMediaPlaybackState
methods.description: Converts internal media session playback state to Windows MediaPlaybackStatus.

methods.name: InitButtonCallbackOnce
methods.description: Registers button press event handler for media controls.

methods.name: OnMediaSessionStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in media session state, updating UI and control states accordingly.

methods.name: RegisterMediaSessionCallbacks
methods.description: Registers callback functions for media session events.

methods.name: UpdateActiveSessionPlatformPlaybackState
methods.description: Updates platform playback state via callback.
